'''Moscow Institute of Electronics and Mathematics''' ('''MIEM'''; {{langx|ru|Московский институт электроники и математики НИУ ВШЭ, МИЭМ}}; also occasionally referred to as ''Moscow Institute of Electronic Engineering''<ref>This is lost in translation, because MIEE was the English official name for another Russian university - ''[[Moscow Institute of Electronic Technology]]'' (currently ''National Research University of Electronic Technology'')</ref>) — a [[Russia]]n [[Higher education|higher]] [[educational institution]] in the field of [[electronics]], [[computer engineering]], and [[applied mathematics]].

==History==
The institute was founded by the joint decree of the [[Communist Party of the Soviet Union|Communist Party]] [[Central Committee of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union|Central Committee]] and the [[Government of the Soviet Union|USSR government]] of 21 April 1962 as the ''Moscow Institute of Electronic Machine Building'' ({{langx|ru|Московский институт электронного машиностроения, МИЭМ}}) from the ''Moscow Evening Machine Building Institute'' ({{langx|ru|Московский вечерний машиностроительный институт}} (founded in 1929).<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.libussr.ru/doc_ussr/usr_5814.htm|title=Центральный комитет КПСС, Совет министров СССР. Постановление от 21 апреля 1962 г. № 374 «О мерах по дальнейшему увеличению подготовки специалистов по радиоэлектронике и электронной технике с высшим и средним специальным образованием»|author=|website=Интернет архив законодательства СССР.|date=|publisher=LibUSSR.RU, 2011 - 2017}}</ref><ref name="miemhist">[https://miem.hse.ru/history/ История МИЭМ НИУ ВШЭ]</ref> It was designed to educate personnel for the technologically advanced enterprises of the USSR's military industry.<ref name="miemhist" /> The institute changed over to the current name in 1993, retaining the same abbreviation.

In 2011, the institute was incorporated into the [[National Research University Higher School of Economics]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20120121132620/http://www.government.ru/gov/results/17784/ Распоряжение Правительства РФ от 30 декабря 2011 г. № 2458-р]</ref> In December 2014, the institute moved to a new building located in the northwestern suburb of Moscow, [[Strogino District|Strogino]], from its previous location at 3 Tryokhsvyatitelskiy lane in central [[Moscow]].<ref>[https://www.hse.ru/fundament/trehsvyat/ Большой Трехсвятительский переулок, 3]</ref>

==Faculties==
As of 2015, the institute has 3 departments:
*Faculty of Electronic Engineering;
*Faculty of Computer Engineering;
*Faculty of Applied Mathematics.

*[[National Research University of Electronic Technology]], another Russian technical institute founded in 1960s within the scope of the Soviet microelectronics program
